jyutping: jiu4 jiu4 fong2 fong2 gam3 V

english.note: This is the all-purpose way to describe someone standing or moving unsteadily, with V such as 企 or 行.

examples.english: He was drunk and began to stagger as he walked.
examples.traditional: 佢飲醉咗，行路搖搖晃晃咁行。
